scenes.tts: You need five kitchen tools to use as beaks, such as a clothespin, tongs, and tweezers. Set up five food stations, from seeds to nectar.
scenes.narration: You need five kitchen tools to use as beaks, such as a clothespin, tongs, and tweezers. Set up five food stations, from seeds to nectar.

scenes.tts: Set the five stations around the table. Lay the beak tools in a row. Your child tries three beaks at each station for thirty seconds and counts what lands in the cup.
scenes.narration: Set the five stations around the table. Lay the beak tools in a row. Your child tries three beaks at each station for thirty seconds and counts what lands in the cup.

scenes.tts: Often the clothespin wins at seeds, and the straw wins at nectar. Your results may differ, and that is useful to talk about.
scenes.narration: Often the clothespin wins at seeds, and the straw wins at nectar. Your results may differ, and that is useful to talk about.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. Beans, seeds, cereal, and pasta are choking hazards for children under four. Nobody eats the food. Keep toddlers away from the water.

items.text: Stay close; small food away from under-4s
